# #3468: Patch: follow-up to #3467 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #3467 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #3467 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42582126293)) found 3 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`e8d5f21f9b55`). `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3467 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/fx/shed.ts:16`: The shed level is one module-wide global with no production reset, so after a game sheds to stage 3 every card face in the app stays still (except a hovered one) until some fx director happens to run about 90 healthy frames of effect work; outside a game no director ever runs, so faces stay still for the rest of the session.
  Evidence: The only writes to the level are `setShedLevel` in director.ts:225 (a slow window) and director.ts:235 (recovery); `resetShedForTests` is the only reset. `dispose()` (director.ts:698-705) does not touch it. `adapt` is called only from `onFrame` (director.ts:598), and the loop sleeps when `hasWork()` is false, so an idle board never recovers. `useMotionSlot` (cards/motionSlots.ts:104-105) reads the global for every face, through `useArtMotion` (cards/cosmetics.ts:700), and that hook runs in CardFace.tsx:417, which renders faces across the whole client, not only the board. PackOpening.tsx:157, StatShowcase.tsx:174 and routes/dev/fx.tsx:173 create their own directors, and those write the same global. Nothing limits shedding to a phone either: three stalls of more than ~720 ms (FX_ADAPT_WINDOW 30 × FX_ADAPT_SLOW_MS 24) on a desktop also freeze it. Fix: reset the level when a director is disposed (or keep it per director), let an idle board recover, and decide on a phone-only gate.
- [ ] `apps/web/src/fx/aura/AuraLayer.tsx:131`: AuraLayer subscribes to the shed pointer at every stage, so every pointermove re-renders it, and each render runs measureAll (getBoundingClientRect on every aura zone, a forced layout) plus drift.sync and wake. That is a new per-move layout cost on the board, desktop included, at stage 0 where the pointer is never used.
  Evidence: `const pointer = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeShed, shedPointer, ...)` is read on every render. FxLayer.tsx:349-357 calls `setShedPointer` on every window pointermove, and shed.ts:63-68 notifies on every changed position. The layout effect at AuraLayer.tsx:191-194 measures after every render (its own comment says so), and the effect at ~271-282 re-syncs the drift engine. `budgetFor` only reads the pointer when `shedAuraScale(shed) !== 1`. The new scenario's own tilt circling (startTilt) fires a pointermove every frame, so it also measures this cost. Fix: read the pointer only at stage 2 or deeper (for example, subscribe to the pointer only when shed ≥ SHED_AURAS), or test boxes against the pointer without making the pointer render state.
- [ ] `apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts:251`: The issue asks for one shared phone budget that faces, tile auras, backdrops, particles and tilt draw from. PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET is never read by any code, and nothing counts those units against it. The ruling describes behavior the code does not have.
  Evidence: grep for PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET in apps/ and e2e/ finds only its definition, a comment in shed.ts:2 and constants.test.ts, which checks only that it equals COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX. R3351000.md says the units 'share six concurrent motion units: a face counts 1, an aura 1, tilt 1'. In practice the six face slots are the existing motion slots, and the tile auras, backdrop and tilt run on top of them with no count and no shedding triggered by a count. The scenario board alone has 5 tile auras, field auras, a backdrop and a tilted card besides the faces. Either enforce the shared count (faces + auras + tilt ≤ PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET on a phone, shedding in the ruled order) or reword the ruling and the constant to say what the code actually does.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42583325935)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Fix the three blocking findings from the after-merge spot-check of #3467 without reverting it: the module-global shed level must reset on director disposal and recover on an idle board, and shed only on phone viewports; `AuraLayer` must stop re-rendering and re-measuring on every pointer move at shed stages 0-1; and the "shared phone motion budget" wording in `R3351000`, `constants.ts`, and `shed.ts` must describe what the code actually does. Each finding is either fixed where it points or answered with evidence, with no weakened checks.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/fx/director.ts` | change | New `phone` option; gate upward shed on it; `hasWork` covers shed stage > 0; `dispose` resets level |
| `apps/web/src/fx/FxLayer.tsx` | change | Pass `phone` from viewport width at director creation |
| `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx` | change | Pass `phone` from `window.innerWidth` at director creation |
| `apps/web/src/stats/StatShowcase.tsx` | change | Same one-line `phone` addition |
| `apps/web/src/routes/dev/fx.tsx` | change | Same one-line `phone` addition |
| `apps/web/src/fx/aura/AuraLayer.tsx` | change | Gate pointer snapshot on shed stage (null below stage 2) |
| `apps/web/src/fx/shed.ts` | change | Header comment only: per-layer budgets plus ordered shed |
| `apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts` | change | `PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET` comment only: faces' share anchors the scale |
| `spec/rulings/R3351000.md` | change | Reword "One shared budget" paragraph to the actual mechanism |
| `spec/pending/3351.md` | change | Same sentence reworded, so the daily fold carries matching text |
| `apps/web/src/fx/director.test.ts` | change | `phone: true` in existing shed tests; three new `R3351000` tests |
| `apps/web/src/fx/aura/AuraLayer.test.tsx` | change | One new `R3351000` pointer-cost test |
| `apps/web/src/fx/constants.test.ts` | change | Comment only in the `R3351000` budget test; assertions stay |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, anything in `crates/`, `apps/edge`, `e2e/`, or the rest of `apps/web`. No new ruling note and no `spec/pending/3468.md`: this amends the existing `R3351000` note in-PR, which the spec README allows. Governing spec: §10.10, §11, `R3351000` with `R200`, `R202`, `R3340000`, `R2787000`; `spec/README.md` "Adding a ruling".

## Steps

1. `apps/web/src/fx/director.ts`, options: add `phone?: boolean` to `FxDirectorOptions` with the doc "true on a phone viewport (narrower than `FX_MOBILE_WIDTH`): only then does `adapt` publish shed stages; default false". Default false keeps desktop behavior safe for any missed caller.
2. `apps/web/src/fx/director.ts`, `adapt`: wrap only the slow-window `setShedLevel(shedStage() + 1)` call in `if (phone)`. Leave the healthy-window recovery (`setShedLevel(shedStage() - 1)`) ungated so a stranded level always drains downward. Desktop keeps its existing `B34` cap halving unchanged.
3. `apps/web/src/fx/director.ts`, `hasWork`: add `\|\| shedStage() > 0` to the returned condition, so an idle board keeps its loop alive through the existing healthy-window path (3 windows of 30 frames per stage) until the level drains to full, then sleeps again. Update the `shedLevel()` method comment to note the phone gate.
4. `apps/web/src/fx/director.ts`, `dispose`: after `clear()`, call `setShedLevel(SHED_FULL)` (import `SHED_FULL` from `./shed.ts`). One director is mounted at a time in production (board, pack, showcase, and dev gallery unmount each other), so resetting the shared level on disposal ends cross-route leaks; do not touch the pointer (its lifecycle stays with `FxLayer`'s unmount cleanup).
5. `apps/web/src/fx/FxLayer.tsx`: in the director-creation layout effect, add `phone: (s.viewportWidth?.() ?? window.innerWidth) < FX_MOBILE_WIDTH` next to the existing `capacity: capacityFor(...)` line. `FX_MOBILE_WIDTH` is already imported.
6. `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx`, `apps/web/src/stats/StatShowcase.tsx`, `apps/web/src/routes/dev/fx.tsx`: add `phone: window.innerWidth < FX_MOBILE_WIDTH` to each `createFxDirector` call and add `FX_MOBILE_WIDTH` to each file's `./constants.ts` or `../../fx/constants.ts` import.
7. `apps/web/src/fx/aura/AuraLayer.tsx`: replace the pointer subscription with a stage-gated snapshot, keeping the level subscription as is:
   `const pointer = useSyncExternalStore(subscribeShed, () => (shedAuraScale(shedLevel()) === 1 ? null : shedPointer()), () => null);`
   Below stage 2 the snapshot is always null, so pointer-move notifications change nothing and React bails out: no re-render, no `measureAll` forced layout, no drift re-sync. At stage 2+ the real pointer flows and the existing `budgetFor` near/far logic (lines 261-268) works unchanged. `shedAuraScale`, `shedLevel`, `shedPointer` are already imported.
8. `apps/web/src/fx/shed.ts` header comment and `apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts` `PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET` comment: reword to the actual mechanism. Faces are capped by the motion slots (`COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX`, 6, on every viewport); tile and aura mote budgets scale with intensity and the phone particle cap (`auraBudget`, `tileMoteBudget` via `capacityFor`); tilt holds one claim; past the phone budget the director sheds emission, then far auras, then non-hovered faces, in that order. Keep the constant value 6 and its equality with the slots.
9. `spec/rulings/R3351000.md`: reword only the "One shared budget" paragraph and its rejected-alternatives line about "a per-layer budget" to match step 8: per-layer phone-scaled budgets plus the ordered shed, with the faces' share anchored at 6 by the motion slots. Keep every `[[R...]]` link, the front matter, and `proven_in` unchanged. Mirror the one changed sentence in `spec/pending/3351.md` so the daily fold carries the same wording.
10. `apps/web/src/fx/director.test.ts`: pass `phone: true` in the three existing `R3351000` tests' `harness(...)` calls (the harness spreads overrides into `createFxDirector`, so no harness change is needed). Add: `it("R3351000 disposing a director resets the shared shed level to full", ...)` (slow windows to stage 3, `dispose`, fresh `harness().director.shedLevel()` is 0); `it("R3351000 an idle shed board recovers to full on healthy frames with no effect work", ...)` (stage 3, then only `frameEvery(16, ...)` with nothing played, level steps 2, 1, 0); `it("R3351000 a desktop director halves its cap on slow windows but never sheds", ...)` (default harness, slow windows, `shedLevel()` stays 0 while `capacity()` drops below `FX_PARTICLE_CAP`).
11. `apps/web/src/fx/aura/AuraLayer.test.tsx`: add `it("R3351000 pointer moves below stage 2 re-render and re-measure nothing", ...)` reusing `fakeSeams`, `board`, `field`, and `mount`: wrap `fx.seams.measure` with a counter, mount the two-aura view at stage 0, record the count and `data-aura-motes`, `act(setShedPointer(...))` three positions, and expect the measure count and motes unchanged. The existing stage-2 halving test stays as the positive case.
12. `apps/web/src/fx/constants.test.ts`: update only the comment inside `it("R3351000 the shared phone motion budget and worst-frame budget", ...)` to the per-layer wording; keep all assertions (`PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET` 6, equals `COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX`, worst-frame bounds).

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/fx/director.test.ts` (steps 1-4, 10)
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/fx/aura/AuraLayer.test.tsx` (step 7, 11)
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/fx/shed.test.ts` (unchanged, guards the store both consumers share)
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/fx/aura/TileAura.test.tsx` (unchanged, level-only consumer)
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/cards/motionSlots.test.ts` (unchanged, stage-3 face behavior)
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/fx/constants.test.ts` (step 12)
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` (touched `tsx`/options types)
- `cargo jackioh spec check` (step 9; also run after any comment edit that cites an `R` id)

## Done when

- A disposed director leaves the shed level at full; an idle shed board returns to full on healthy frames with no effects; desktop viewports never pass stage 0 while phone viewports shed 1-2-3 and recover, all covered by the new `director.test.ts` tests.
- Pointer moves below stage 2 cause no `AuraLayer` re-render, no `measureAll`, and no mote change, covered by the new `AuraLayer.test.tsx` test; stage-2 near/far halving still passes.
- `PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET` is read nowhere as a counter and the ruling, constant, and shed header all describe the per-layer mechanism instead; `spec check` is green.
- The exact commands above are green with no skipped, ignored, or weakened test and no new lint suppression.

## Risks

- Keeping the loop alive while shed > 0 costs roughly 90 healthy frames per stage after effects end on a slow phone; bounded, rare, and far cheaper than a stuck-still session. A timer-based recovery was rejected as new clock machinery in the FX layer.
- `dispose` resetting the shared level assumes one mounted director at a time, which holds for the four production call sites (routes unmount each other) but not for tests mounting several; tests already call `resetShedForTests` between cases.
- Desktop keeps `B34` cap halving without shedding: a stranded desktop level can only come from shared-module tests, where the healthy path still drains it.
- `TileAura` and `motionSlots` subscribe to the level only, not the pointer, so they need no change; `CardFace`, tilt, pack, showcase, and gallery faces inherit the fix through the store.

## Open questions

None. The phone-only gate the issue left open is decided in steps 1-2 and 5-6 (shed publishes on phone viewports only; desktop keeps cap halving), and the budget question in steps 8-9 (reword to the actual mechanism rather than enforcing a cross-layer counter the code has no allocator for).
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->
